project.catalog-heading: From utility to bulk transaction in one familiar domain.
project.catalog-description: Each example shows the frontend call, API contract and relevant NewHeap mechanism. Screens remain usable with sample data when authentication is unavailable.
project.directory-description: Filter, select, change status or open the edit modal.
project.filtering-description: The request builder translates UI state into a safe collection request. The backend only executes filters, search fields and sorting allowed through attributes.
project.low-level-filter-description: The arrays and constructors remain available for dynamic request trees and diagnostics, but are not the default for ordinary filters.
project.partial-description: The concrete ProjectService opens the transaction, executes UpdatePartialAsync, publishes the project event and only then commits. The controller contains no domain logic.
project.bulk-title: Multiple partial updates in one transaction
project.bulk-description: ProjectService owns the outer transaction; BulkAsync joins that scope and the summary event is published before the single commit.
project.utilities-description: Short live examples for string normalization and filenames from response headers.
project.edit-modal-description: The same component supports create and edit. appOnInit initializes its form data without overriding NhModalMutateBaseComponent's Angular hook; NhModalService opens it with modalClasses: 'large'.
project.key-help: Short, unique and recognizable, for example PORTAL.
project.name: Name
project.case-catalog-description: Search the complete library surface and see which examples are executable and which are still being built.
project.search-cases-placeholder: Search by id, concept or library type
project.implementation-pending: Implementation follows in a later vertical batch.
project.collection-playground-description: Build nested filters, ranges, null checks, multi-sort and pagination with the real NewHeap request models. Enable the unsafe field to demonstrate attribute protection.
project.fluent-api-description: Use shortcuts for ordinary conditions and sorting. Only use FilterRequestOptions to compose nested trees.
project.utility-playground-description: Execute the smaller library helpers and inspect their real input, output and concurrency order.
project.enum-dropdown-title: Enum dropdowns from a shared option builder
project.enum-dropdown-description: The enum value remains identical to the API contract; the translation-key selector maps PascalCase to dash-case keys inside the project module.
project.deferred-dropdown-title: Deferred lazy dropdown with selected fallback
project.deferred-dropdown-description: The sample explicitly enables the recommended opt-in: the full collection loads only on first open. A preselected value is fetched immediately through selectedLazyLoadLambda; identical concurrent lookups share one request.
project.mutex-description: Three concurrently started operations demonstrably run one at a time.
project.encoding-description: Converts a real text Blob to a data URL through FileReader.
project.observable-description: Turns an Observable into a TypedResult using the library prototype extension.
project.cookie-description: Sets, reads and removes one safe sample cookie.
project.auth-playground-description: Run the real NewHeap authentication flows against the API or activate a local claim set to safely explore permissions, pipes, session expiration and division logic.
project.expiring-session-active: The session expires in 10 seconds; token state is then cleared and the login page opens.
project.media-playground-title: Project documents in the NewHeap media library
project.media-playground-description: Manage division-scoped folders, uploads, downloads, metadata, translations, search, thumbnails and events through the real media stack.
project.transaction-playground-description: Follow a project write, typed event and rollback in one service-owned unit of work and verify that no side effect escapes.
project.platform-playground-description: Run library services directly and inspect the result without extra application abstractions.
project.http-deduplication-title: HTTP response shapes and in-flight GET deduplication
project.http-deduplication-description: The preferred configuration is enabled. Two concurrent identical GET calls share one network request; the same URL may execute again after completion.
project.notification-playground-description: Polling, badge, mark-as-read and archiving through the real NewHeap notification service.
project.toast-sample-message: The reusable NewHeap toast container is active.
project.interaction-playground-description: Run the real collection base lifecycle through the NewHeap appOn hooks and place ASP.NET ModelState and TaskResult errors on their intended form controls.
project.collection-lifecycle-note: appOnInit runs before the first load. beforeLoad, onLoad and afterLoad belong to every collection load; appOnDestroy is for component-specific cleanup.
project.page-lifecycle-description: Change the project name and navigate away. The page uses the NewHeap appOn hooks; the cancel guard only asks for confirmation when the form is dirty.
project.page-lifecycle-note: Override appOnInit, appOnInitAndLoad, appAfterViewInit and appOnDestroy. Do not override the base Angular ngOn hooks.
project.authorization-role-manager-access: Application-wide view, manage and confidential project access.
project.authorization-role-viewer-access: Application-wide view only; manage stays hidden and returns 403.
project.authorization-role-division-editor-acces: Project permissions inside the active Sample North division.
project.authorization-role-project-editor-access: Confidential access to Authorization Alpha only.
project.authorization-levels-description: Sign in with each account and compare visible actions with the API's real 200/403 responses.
project.authorization-application-description: Manager and viewer share view, while only the manager role carries manage.
project.authorization-division-description: The division editor receives project.view through sample-division-editor for Sample North only.
project.authorization-project-description: The project-specific claim combines a resource id with a permission. Alpha is allowed; Beta is not.
project.authentication-overrides-description: Keep the JWT compact and hydrate current, potentially large authorization claims during the request.
project.authentication-service-override-descript: WithAuthenticationService<T> preserves the NewHeap endpoints, cookies and refresh flow while allowing username and token-claim behavior to be overridden.
project.request-claims-transformation-descriptio: IClaimsTransformation reads current claims once per request, prevents duplicates and makes a removed user's token anonymous.
